query: We want to add a feature that summarizes long support tickets into a 3-sentence summary for our agents. Can you build the prompt for it?
expected_behavior: Refuses to start with the prompt: insists on building an eval set of real ticket/summary cases and a grading rubric first
Defines what a good summary means (faithful to the ticket, no invented facts, within 3 sentences) as a gradable rubric before iterating
Recommends starting with the smallest/cheapest model that could plausibly pass, then running the eval, and only moving up if it fails
Treats context assembly deliberately: system instructions plus the ticket, with an explicit output-length cap and token budget
States a cost-per-request and P95 latency target and names caching or streaming as levers, not an afterthought
Adds a grounding guardrail so the summary cannot introduce claims not present in the ticket
